summary: 同样的风险，换成“避免损失”或“争取收益”，人们往往会作出不同选择。作者把这种心理从个人推到企业与政府，最后落到专家如实说明风险的责任。

paragraphs.brief: 从运动到政治，个人和集体都会权衡危险与收益。
sentences: We run risks.
我们都会冒险。
Most of the time we ignore them; sometimes we stop and decide how to deal with them.
大多数时候我们对风险置之不理，有时则会停下来决定如何应对。
That’s life.
生活就是如此。
Risks arise in sports, in business, in personal relationships; they are present in the laboratory, in political calculations, everywhere.
无论在体育、商业、人际关系、实验室还是政治权衡中，风险都无处不在。
Acting individually, we often prefer to gain some benefit by accepting some danger.
作为个体，我们常常愿意承担一些危险，以换取一定收益。
Acting collectively, we make similar trade-offs.
集体行动时，我们也会作出类似的权衡。

paragraphs.brief: 科学可以澄清风险，但人们即使了解证据也未必改变行为。
sentences: When society must assess risks, and those risks can be clarified, at least in part, by science, technology or mathematics, the responsibility of the research community is to be clear and complete.
当社会需要评估风险，而科学、技术或数学至少能部分阐明这些风险时，研究界有责任把情况说得清楚、完整。
But that is not always so easy.
不过，要做到这一点并不总是容易。
Furthermore, too few people pay full attention to the best evidence, much less modify their behaviors as a result.
此外，肯充分重视最有力证据的人很少，更不用说据此改变行为了。
Even when the evidence of high risk is clear – about smoking, for instance – many will deny the risk, or dispute it, or accept that it exists and still go ahead.
即使危险已有明确证据，比如吸烟，许多人仍会否认风险、质疑它，或虽承认它存在却照旧行事。
As a former cigarette smoker, I understand denial.
作为一名曾经的吸烟者，我能理解这种否认心理。

paragraphs.brief: 相同的概率信息会引出合理反应，也会引起极端行为。
sentences: Perhaps more important than the basic facts of risk are the varied perception of it.
人们对风险的不同感知，也许比风险的基本事实更重要。

Hearing the prediction of 60% chance of rain, or recognizing the minuscule likelihood of becoming ill from a flu shot, most people understand the right responses: take your umbrella and get your flu shot.
听说降雨概率为六成，或了解到接种流感疫苗后患病的可能性极小，大多数人都知道该怎么做：带上雨伞，或去接种疫苗。
But some, fearfully but irrationally, go to the extreme and stay at home and avoid all contact with other people.
但有些人出于恐惧而失去理性，走向极端，索性待在家里，避免与任何人接触。
Irrational decisions occasionally affect us all.
我们每个人偶尔都会作出不理智的决定。
When it comes to risks the best odds do not always influence people to make the correct decision.
面对风险，即使知道哪种选择胜算最大，人们也不总会作出正确决定。

paragraphs.brief: 人们愿意为避免损失冒更大风险，倾向维持现状。
sentences: In her book, The Universe and the Teacup, the science writer K. C. Cole reminds us that the risks of losing something and gaining something appear to be calculated in our minds according to quite different scales.
科普作家 K. C. 科尔在《宇宙与茶杯》中提醒我们，衡量可能的损失和可能的收益时，人似乎会采用截然不同的尺度。
People will risk a lot to prevent a loss, she notes; some people will rush into a burning building to save a pet.
她指出，人们愿意为避免损失而冒很大风险，有人甚至会冲进着火的建筑去救宠物。

But they will usually risk very little if the only perceived outcome is a possible gain; many people won’t even risk pursuing an exciting job, if the current job, though unfulfilling, remains comfortable.
但如果看得见的回报仅仅是有可能获益，人们通常不愿冒什么险。只要现有工作还算安稳，许多人即使并不满意，也不愿冒险去争取一份更令人振奋的工作。
That psychological mechanism, a desire to maintain the status quo, helps explain the high hurdles that any rational risk assessment must confront.
这种想维持现状的心理机制，有助于解释理性评估风险时为何会遇到重重障碍。

paragraphs.brief: 低价芯片冲击英特尔，显示忽视外部变化对企业的危险。
sentences: Organizations face the same hurdles whenever they must cope with major shifts in policy.
组织在应对重大政策转变时也会遇到同样的障碍。

In his classic examination of the character of high-tech industry, Only the Paranoid Survive, Andrew S. Grove gives a perceptive account of a crisis that took place during his tenure as Chairman of the Intel Corporation.
安德鲁·格罗夫在分析高科技行业特征的经典著作《只有偏执狂才能生存》中，深刻记述了他任英特尔董事长期间的一场危机。
The business environment for Intel and its competitors was transformed by a flood of low-cost memory chips from Japan, and Intel made the difficult decision to abandon its chip-making business.
大量低价日本存储芯片的涌入改变了英特尔及其竞争对手的经营环境，英特尔艰难地决定退出这一芯片业务。

Such a period of change in the outside world is filled with danger, Grove notes, precisely because it is so easy for executives to try to disregard it or misinterpret the mounting evidence showing the profound risks of not making change at the very core.
格罗夫指出，外部世界发生变化时危险重重，恰恰因为高管很容易选择无视变化，或误读那些不断增多、揭示不作根本改变将面临重大风险的证据。

The distinction Cole cites is instructive here: one reason management and staff may not act is that they tend to focus on the potential gains of risking change (which they characterize as small), rather than on the catastrophic losses that risking change could prevent.
科尔指出的区别在此很有启发。管理层和员工迟迟不行动的一个原因，是他们专注于冒险改变可能带来的收益，并认为收益很小，却忽视了改变可能避免的灾难性损失。
The period becomes critical for a company, according to Grove, and deadly when unattended to.
格罗夫指出，这段时期对企业至关重要，若置之不理，后果将是致命的。

paragraphs.brief: 找到能阻止生态恶化的关键行动，有助于促使环保机构投入资源。
sentences: Likewise, at the national level, and even the global one, institutions tend to be more willing to take a risk if it means avoiding a loss, than they are if it might confer a gain.
同样，在国家乃至全球层面，若承担风险能够避免损失，机构往往更愿意行动，仅仅可能获益则较难促使它们冒险。
Almost everyone, for instance, sees the signs of ecological decay.
例如，几乎人人都看得到生态恶化的迹象。
Reid J. Lifset’s article, ‘Full Accounting’, describes newly developed techniques for clarifying which critical decision would have the highest pay-offs for the environment.
里德·利夫塞特在《全面核算》一文中介绍了新技术，用于辨明哪些关键决策能为环境带来最大收益。
Once these ‘leverage points’ as he calls them, are located, many environmental organizations will be willing to risk the resources needed to prevent further deterioration.
一旦找到他所称的这些“杠杆点”，许多环保组织就愿意承担投入资源的风险，以阻止环境进一步恶化。

paragraphs.brief: 眼前需要容易掩盖教育研究投资的长期收益。
sentences: More complicated are decisions by nations to invest broadly in educational research.
各国是否大规模投资教育研究，是个更复杂的决策问题。

Some governmental leaders are oblivious to the risks posed by social under-investment, because the urgent needs of the present take precedence over actions that would give rise to even more substantial gains in the future.
有些政府领导人没有意识到社会投入不足带来的风险，因为眼前的迫切需要优先于那些未来可能带来更大收益的行动。
Their attitude is that today’s risks must be manageable, and that tomorrow’s gains are at the very least difficult to measure.
他们的看法是，今天的风险必须是可控的，而明天的收益至少很难衡量。
Better consideration and decision making for what lies ahead is essential.
人们需要更周全地思考未来，并据此作出更好的决策。

paragraphs.brief: 个人可以乐观或悲观，专家都应谨慎衡量并诚实说明风险。
sentences: Nevertheless, I confess to being an optimist.
尽管如此，我承认自己是个乐观的人。
My glass is generally half full – though that may not help me handle risk.
我一般会觉得杯子“还有半杯水”，虽然这种看法未必有助于我应对风险。

Whether one’s temperament is optimistic or pessimistic, everyone in our scientific and engineering community has a social responsibility: measure with care and portray with honesty the level of risk involved in any action or decision.
无论生性乐观还是悲观，科学界与工程界的每个人都有一份社会责任，即谨慎衡量并诚实说明任何行动或决策涉及的风险程度。

items.en: the areas of study that help us understand risk
items.zh: 有助于人们理解风险的学科领域
items.why: science, technology or mathematics 是列举出来的学科，指向 B 段。

items.en: reference to key actions that might benefit the world
items.zh: 提到可能让世界受益的关键行动
items.why: highest pay-offs for the environment 把“让世界受益”具体化为环境收益，下一句称之为 leverage points。

items.en: examples of statistical predictions that the majority of the public react to in the same way
items.zh: 多数公众会作出相同反应的统计预测实例
items.why: 60% 的降雨概率和接种疫苗后患病的微小概率是两个例子，most people 给出人群范围。

items.en: the variety of contexts in which risk occurs
items.zh: 风险出现在哪些不同的场景中
items.why: 体育、商业、人际关系、实验室和政治活动构成了题干所说的多种场景。

items.en: mention of a habit that has been proved to be very risky
items.zh: 提到一种已被证明风险很高的习惯
items.why: about smoking, for instance 是藏在插入语里的具体习惯。

items.en: reference to market forces motivating change
items.zh: 提到推动变革的市场力量
items.why: 来自日本的低价存储芯片改变了竞争环境，迫使英特尔作出退出业务的决定。

items.en: the writer’s current attitude towards risk
items.zh: 作者本人目前对风险的态度
items.why: 从 I confess 和 an optimist 可以看出这是作者直接表明自己的态度。

items.en: a reason why some individuals avoid making a career change
items.zh: 有些人不愿更换工作的一个原因
items.why: 现有工作虽然并不令人满足，却仍然安稳。comfortable 给出了不换工作的具体原因。

items.en: how some people over-react to information about risk
items.zh: 有些人会怎样对风险信息反应过度
items.why: go to the extreme 总领细节，待在家里、避免接触任何人就是过度反应的表现。

items.en: K. C. Cole points out that avoiding a loss seems more important to people than …
items.zh: 科尔指出，对人们而言，避免损失似乎比什么更重要？

items.en: According to Andrew S. Grove, it can be very dangerous for companies to ignore …
items.zh: 格罗夫认为，企业忽视什么可能会很危险？
items.solution: 外部环境正在发生的变化。

items.en: Reid J. Lifset argues that environmental agencies can benefit from …
items.zh: 利夫塞特认为，环保机构可以从什么中获益？
items.answer: D · recent findings on the most effective solutions to problems.
items.solution: 关于哪些解决办法最有效的最新研究发现。

items.en: The writer suggests that government leaders need to focus more on …
items.zh: 作者建议政府领导人应更加重视什么？

items.en: At the end of the passage the writer concludes that …
items.zh: 作者在文章结尾得出了什么结论？
correct: experts should be truthful about risk to the public.
专家应向公众如实说明风险。

pairs: 学科类别 ↔ 文中的三个例子
多数公众 ↔ 大多数人
a flood of low-cost memory chips from Japan
市场力量 ↔ 低价芯片大量涌入
反应过度 ↔ 走向极端
portray with honesty the level of risk
如实说明 ↔ 诚实呈现风险程度
points: 这组题允许重复使用段落。C 段第 2 句回答“多数人的反应”，第 3 句回答“部分人的过度反应”。
a habit 要找具体行为，writer’s attitude 要找第一人称立场。两题都谈风险，但应找的证据不同。
clauses: Some governmental leaders are oblivious to the risks
because 引出忽视风险的原因。that would give rise to … 修饰 actions，说明哪些行动能带来长期收益。
先读“领导人忽视风险”，再读眼前需求怎样挤占未来行动。
everyone in our scientific and engineering community has a social responsibility
Whether … optimistic or pessimistic 给出两种情况，后面用 measure 和 portray 具体说明责任。
先读“人人都有责任”，再看责任的两部分。
